title: Systematic Evaluation of Single-Cell Foundation Model Interpretability Reveals Attention Captures Co-Expression Rather Than Unique Regulatory Signal

bias_targets.methodology: Using expression residualisation, degree-preserving null models, and propensity-score matching to isolate pairwise regulatory signals and evaluate if attention edges are confounded by univariate gene-level features like mean expression, variance, and dropout rate.

Calculating the residual between the total causal effect and the sum of single-component activation patching estimates to quantify non-additivity and identify systematic bias in mechanistic interpretability tools.
